key_concepts: Energy is the ability or capacity to do work
The SI unit of energy is the joule
Work is the product of force and displacement
Work done lifting an object against gravity is W=mgh
Potential energy is stored energy due to an object's position
Potential energy is calculated using PE=mgh
Potential energy depends on mass, height, and acceleration due to gravity
Kinetic energy is the energy of motion
Kinetic energy is calculated using KE=1/2mv^2
Kinetic energy depends on mass and speed
Doubling mass doubles kinetic energy when speed is constant
Doubling speed increases kinetic energy four times when mass is constant
